mobile_vulkan.description: Resource-constrained mobile GPU targeting Vulkan with GLSL ES 310

desktop_vulkan.description: High-performance desktop GPU targeting Vulkan with GLSL 450

console_metal.description: Console platform using Metal Shading Language, favoring minimal register pressure

metrics.binary_size: File size in bytes of the optimized .spv binary
metrics.instruction_count: Number of non-comment, non-empty lines in spirv-dis output
metrics.id_count: Number of unique %identifier tokens in spirv-dis output

scoring.formula: For each metric m: norm(s,m) = (value(s,m) - min(m)) / (max(m) - min(m)) if max(m) != min(m), else 0. Score(s,p) = sum(weight(p,m) * norm(s,m) for m in metrics). Strategy with lowest score is recommended.
